# Selected Heretic MLX metadata

Exact public config and safetensors header from
[`deadbydawn101/gemma-4-E2B-Heretic-Uncensored-mlx-4bit`](https://huggingface.co/deadbydawn101/gemma-4-E2B-Heretic-Uncensored-mlx-4bit/tree/cde01efcb11f8a12e88a953b752fc16062aa1486),
revision `cde01efcb11f8a12e88a953b752fc16062aa1486`.

`inventory.json` is an independent Python/struct inventory of the authenticated
local source file. It includes full-file/config/header hashes, selected and
excluded byte sums, counts and the BF16 projection span. No weight payload is
bundled. Metadata tests establish neither execution nor model quality/adoption.
